stem.text: The diagram shows the changes in electrical activity in the heart muscle during one cardiac cycle. This is called an electrocardiograph (ECG).

stem.alt: Single electrocardiograph waveform with the labels 'sinoatrial node stimulated' and 'stimulates ventricular systole'.
